Treatment history matrix is the main output of the RMD file 'PISurveys_CLP_TreatmentHistoryMatrix' in analysis>CLP DLNM.

```{r load data}

IceOut_Predictions <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/exploration/PARsInventory/2. Ice out/pred_iceout26.csv")

#Chl_A <- read_csv("G:/Shared drives/Walsh Lab/Projects/MAISRC IAPM/Data/MPCA/Chlorophyll A/MPCA_ChlorophyllA_2010_2025_Clean.csv")

Secchi <- read_csv("G:/Shared drives/Walsh Lab/Projects/MAISRC IAPM/Data/MPCA Water Quality/Secchi/MPCA_Secchi_2010_2025_Clean.csv")

#This is the dat_dlnm output from db_sub_pa in 0. Loading and Preparing Data
PI_surveys <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/MVerhoeven_2020_model/2026 data/PI_surveys.csv")

LakeMorphology <- read_csv("G:/Shared drives/Walsh Lab/Projects/MAISRC IAPM/Data/Lake Morphology/LakeMorphologyDetails.csv")


#average snow depth
Snow_Depth <- read_excel("G:/Shared drives/Walsh Lab/Projects/MAISRC IAPM/Data/Climate Data/CLP Analysis Lakes Average Snow Depth.xlsx")
```


```{r set up dataframes}
#adding columns. CLP_trt will be main working dataframe
new_cols <- c(
  "Year", "County", "Trt", "Trt_Date", "acres_trt", "perc_lz_trt",
    "prop_lz"
)

# Add missing columns initialized as NA
missing_cols <- setdiff(new_cols, colnames(treatment_history_matrix))

treatment_history_matrix[missing_cols] <- NA
CLP_trt <- treatment_history_matrix

CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  mutate(SURVEY_START = mdy(SURVEY_START)) %>%
  mutate(date_lag0_before = mdy(date_lag0_before)) %>%
  mutate(date_lag0_after = mdy(date_lag0_after)) %>%
  mutate(DOW = str_pad(DOW, width = 8, side = "left", pad = "0"))

#load in lake area data
MN_lake_morphology <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/data/MN_Lakes_Areas.csv")

MN_lake_morphology <- MN_lake_morphology %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.numeric(DOW))

CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  left_join(
    MN_lake_morphology %>% select(DOW, LakeAreaAcres, LAKE_NAME, `15ft_LittoralZone_Acres`,
    Percentage_15ft_LittoralZone), 
    by = c("DOW" = "DOW")
  ) %>%
  #turning percent into proportion
  rename(Proportion.littoral = Percentage_15ft_LittoralZone) %>%
  mutate(Proportion.littoral = Proportion.littoral/100)

#change the 2s to 1s in the lag matrix. 2s were used to differentiate lag treatments where we knew the year but not the specific treatment date. For this analysis that doesn't matter, so changing it all to 1 or 0.
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  mutate(across(11:18, ~ ifelse(.x == 2, 1, .x)))

#populated Trt column based on if there is a lag0 treatment. 1 = lake was treated that year, 0 = untreated
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>% 
  mutate(Trt = if_else(lag0_before == 1 | lag0_after == 1, 1, 0, missing = 0)) %>%
  mutate(Year = year(SURVEY_START)) %>%
  mutate(prop_lz = `15ft_LittoralZone_Acres`/LakeAreaAcres)



CLP_trt$acres_trt <- as.numeric(CLP_trt$perc_lz_trt)
#populate Trt_Date with the treatment date from lag0before and lag0after columns
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  mutate(Trt_Date = coalesce(date_lag0_before, date_lag0_after)) %>%
  #same with acres treated
  mutate(acres_trt = coalesce(acres_lag0_before, acres_lag0_after)) %>%
  #calcualte percent littoral zone treated
  mutate(perc_lz_trt = (acres_trt / `15ft_LittoralZone_Acres`)*100)

#ice off dates from Jake's prediction model
IceOut_Predictions <- IceOut_Predictions %>%
  mutate(DOW = str_sub(ID, 5))

CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  left_join(
    IceOut_Predictions %>% select(winter.year, DOW, est),
    by = c("Year" = "winter.year", "DOW" = "DOW")
  ) %>%
  rename(Ice_off = est)

#ignore chl a for now
# Join chlorophyll A MPCA data
# Chl_A <- Chl_A %>%
#   mutate(ActivityDate = mdy(ActivityStartDate)) %>%
#   mutate(year = year(as.Date(ActivityDate)))
# 
# previous year, which month?
# CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
# #   left_join(
# #     Chl_A %>% select(year, DOW, ResultMeasureValue, ActivityDate),
# #     by = c("Year" = "year", "DOW" = "DOW")
# #   ) %>%
# #   rename(Chl_A = ResultMeasureValue)


##join secchi data
Secchi <- Secchi %>%
  mutate(year = year(as.Date(ActivityStartDate)))

# CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
#   left_join(
#     Secchi %>% select(year, DOW, ResultMeasureValue, ActivityStartDate),
#     by = c("Year" = "year", "DOW" = "DOW")
#   ) %>%
#   rename(prev_aug_secchi = ResultMeasureValue)


# Step 1: Filter Secchi data for August and extract the year
secchi_aug_prev <- Secchi %>%
  filter(month(ActivityStartDate) == 8) %>%
  group_by(DOW, year) %>%
  summarize(
    prev_aug_secchi = mean(ResultMeasureValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 2: Create a matching key in CLP_trt for (Year - 1) and join
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  mutate(prev_year = Year - 1) %>%
  left_join(
    secchi_aug_prev,
    by = c("DOW" = "DOW", "prev_year" = "year")
  ) %>%
  select(-prev_year) # Clean up temporary joining column
```


```{r p.crispus FO}
PI_surveys <- PI_surveys %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.numeric(DOW))


CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.numeric(DOW)) %>%
  # 1. Build a lookup with the earliest AprMay survey and earliest June survey per DOW/year
  left_join(
    PI_surveys %>%
      select(DOW, year, potamogeton_crispus, SURVEY_START) %>%
      mutate(
        SURVEY_START = as.Date(SURVEY_START),
        .month_num = month(SURVEY_START)
      ) %>%
      filter(.month_num %in% c(4, 5, 6)) %>%
      mutate(
        .month_group = ifelse(.month_num %in% c(4, 5), "APRMAY", "JUNE")
      ) %>%
      group_by(DOW, year, .month_group) %>%
      slice_min(SURVEY_START, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(DOW, year, .month_group, potamogeton_crispus) %>%
      # 2. Reshape so APRMAY and JUNE each get their own column
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = .month_group,
        values_from = potamogeton_crispus,
        names_glue = "{.month_group}_pcrispus_FO"
      ) %>%
      mutate(across(c(APRMAY_pcrispus_FO, JUNE_pcrispus_FO), as.numeric)),
    by = c("DOW" = "DOW", "Year" = "year")
  )


#round to two decimal places
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  mutate(
    mutate(across(c(APRMAY_pcrispus_FO, JUNE_pcrispus_FO, prev_aug_secchi), ~ round(.x, 2)))
  )

#calculate years previously treated for CLP
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt  %>%
  mutate(
    YrsTrt = rowSums(
      across(c(lag0_before, lag0_after, lag1:lag8)) == 1, 
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

CLP_trt <- CLP_trt  %>%
  mutate(DIFF.4.6 = JUNE_pcrispus_FO - APRMAY_pcrispus_FO)

#lake max depth
LakeMorphology <- LakeMorphology %>%
  rename(DOW = DOWLKNUM) %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.numeric(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(DOW = sprintf("%08d", DOW))


CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  mutate(DOW = sprintf("%08d", DOW)) %>%
  left_join(
    LakeMorphology %>% select(DOW, LK_MAXDEPT),
    by = c("DOW" = "DOW")
  )


```
 
```{r meteorlogical data join}
#snow depth
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  left_join(
    Snow_Depth %>%
      # Calculate the mean across December, January, February, and March for each row
      mutate(Snow = rowMeans(across(c(December, January, February, March)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      select(Trt_Year, Snow),
    by = c("Year" = "Trt_Year")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Snow = round(Snow, 1))
```

```{r changing column names}
#to be compatible with MVerhoeven 2020 analysis
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  rename(
    Lake.ID = DOW,
    Lake.x = LAKE_NAME,
    PrevAUGSecchi = prev_aug_secchi,
    JUNPcri = JUNE_pcrispus_FO,
    APRMAYPcri = APRMAY_pcrispus_FO,
    Lake.area.acre = LakeAreaAcres,
    litt.ac = '15ft_LittoralZone_Acres',
    Max.depth = LK_MAXDEPT,
    Acres_Chem = acres_trt,
    perc.lit.chem = perc_lz_trt
  )

CLP_trt_lag_matrix <- CLP_trt %>%
  select(Lake.ID, Year, Lake.x, Trt, YrsTrt, PrevAUGSecchi, Snow, APRMAYPcri, JUNPcri, DIFF.4.6, County, Lake.area.acre, Proportion.littoral, Max.depth, Acres_Chem, litt.ac, perc.lit.chem, Ice_off, lag0_before, lag0_after, acres_lag0_before, acres_lag0_after, date_lag0_before, date_lag0_after, lag1, lag2, lag3, lag4, lag5, lag6, lag7, lag8)


CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  select(Lake.ID, Year, Lake.x, Trt, YrsTrt, PrevAUGSecchi, Snow, APRMAYPcri, JUNPcri, DIFF.4.6, County, Lake.area.acre, Proportion.littoral, Max.depth, Acres_Chem, litt.ac, perc.lit.chem, Ice_off)
```


```{r remove duplicates}
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  distinct(Lake.ID, Year, Acres_Chem, YrsTrt, PrevAUGSecchi, APRMAYPcri, JUNPcri, .keep_all = TRUE)

CLP_trt_lag_matrix <- CLP_trt %>%
  distinct(Lake.ID, Year, Acres_Chem, YrsTrt, PrevAUGSecchi, APRMAYPcri, JUNPcri, .keep_all = TRUE)
```



```{r write csv}
write.csv(CLP_trt_lag_matrix, file = "~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/MVerhoeven_2020_model/2026 data/CLP_trt_lag_matrix.csv")

write.csv(CLP_trt, file = "~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/MVerhoeven_2020_model/2026 data/CLP_trt.csv")
```
